summary: Iteration 33 end-to-end regression + three new features (session check-in / album share+latest / leader personal quotes). Backend pytest file test_iter33_checkin_leaders_albums.py ran 40 tests: 38 PASS, 2 FAIL — both failures caused by one critical bug (session check-in attendance endpoint rejects valid payloads with 422). Frontend regression: all 18 public routes loaded with 200 on desktop 1920x1080, and the mobile 390x844 spot-checks (/, /leadership, /initiatives, /sessions, /gallery, /donate, /contact) had no horizontal overflow and non-empty content; mobile menu opens and shows 9 nav links. Home page shows leader-strip, leader-strip-quote-* and home-latest-album with a working home-latest-album-link. Album detail page /gallery/album/<slug> renders album-share with share-facebook, share-whatsapp, share-x and share-copy. Admin › Sessions renders session-checkin-<sid> links that navigate to /session-checkin/<sid>; the mobile check-in page shows sci-title, sci-count, sci-search, 3 sci-row-* and sci-mark-rest. Admin › Leadership edit form shows leader-quote-input with current value and placeholder. /leadership LeaderModal shows leader-modal-quote with the stored personal quote. Clicking sci-present-<id> optimistically marks the row but after reload sci-count is still '0 / 3 checked in' and the POST silently 422s — reproduces the critical bug below.

critical.issue: Endpoint uses the WRONG AttendanceIn Pydantic model (the one defined at server.py line 6990 for member meetings — `{attendance: dict}`), not the per-session model at line 5364 (`{updates: dict, all: Optional[str]}`). The second `class AttendanceIn(BaseModel)` at line 6990 shadows the first by name at module import time, and the dated-session route at line 9743 then binds to the shadowed class. Result: every FE call POSTs `{updates: {...}}` or `{all: 'no_show'}` and the API returns 422 missing-field 'attendance'. Attendance cannot be saved — Feature B is completely non-functional despite the UI appearing to work.
critical.fix: Rename one of the two AttendanceIn classes. Simplest: rename the per-session attendance model near line 9743 to e.g. `SessionAttendanceIn` and change the route signature `admin_session_attendance(..., payload: SessionAttendanceIn, ...)`. Alternatively rename the meeting one (line 6990) to `MeetingAttendanceIn`. (The duplicate at line 5364 vs 6990 is the same shadowing problem — the member-meetings endpoint at line 7028 only works because `attendance` matches its earlier model's shape; the dated-session endpoint does not.

minor.issue: server.py is now 9808 lines with three classes named AttendanceIn and three classes named GalleryEditIn-ish patterns elsewhere; moving routers into modules would prevent future name-shadowing bugs like the one above.

ui_bugs.issue: mark() optimistically updates local state and then calls `api.post` with no try/catch — when the backend 422s the user sees the toggle appear to work but there is no error toast and no rollback. After reload sci-count returns to 0. Minimum fix even after the backend bug is resolved: wrap the POST in try/catch, toast on failure, and revert the row state.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Sessions → Check-in → mark present → reload
integration_issues.issue: Attendance never persists because POST /api/admin/sessions/{sid}/attendance is 422ing (see critical backend bug). sci-count stays at 0 / 3 after reload.

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Rename the duplicate AttendanceIn class so /api/admin/sessions/{sid}/attendance binds to the model with `updates` and `all` fields (see backend_issues.critical for exact repro and fix).
Harden SessionCheckIn.mark() with try/catch + error toast + state rollback so attendance failures surface to the user.
Consider splitting server.py (9808 lines) into routers — the AttendanceIn bug is a direct consequence of a single-file module with repeating class names.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py defines `class AttendanceIn` three times (lines 5364, 6990, and uses it again at 9743). Python keeps only the last binding of the name; FastAPI resolves `payload: AttendanceIn` at decorator time, so each route silently binds to whichever version is current at that line. The dated-session route gets the wrong one. Please rename or namespace these.
Similarly the duplication risk exists for other reused model names across 9k+ lines — recommend splitting into routers (sessions, gallery, leaders, members, admin) soon.
SessionCheckIn.jsx mark() has no error handling. Any 4xx/5xx on attendance disappears silently because the state was already updated optimistically.
LeaderStrip imports DEFAULT_LEADERS from pages/Leadership — circular-looking dependency; move the constant to /data/.
`_album_slug` depends on title so renaming an auto-album from Admin still breaks previously shared /gallery/album/<slug> links (noted previously, still true).
Public /api/gallery/albums rebuilds the album list from up to 2000 media + 500 metas every call — add a short TTL cache before gallery grows.

The AttendanceIn shadowing bug makes test_attendance_per_row_toggle and test_attendance_mark_rest_noshow fail with 422; those two tests will pass automatically once the main agent renames the class. Public page HTML regression intentionally only asserts the SPA index.html loads (status 200 + <div id="root">); for route 404s you have to click through them in Playwright and watch for empty text — all 18 listed public routes rendered with text > 1000 chars and no horizontal overflow at 1920 and at 390 in this run.
